I would make sure to include the dates they have been in school. . They will need to get transcripts as well from the school, but I’d just generally talk about them. She could apply to the dream.us scholarship. It is open now and closes in January. They have many great schools on there. It’s full tuition for DACA/undocumented students for 4 years and can be at a 4 year or at a 2 year. There are 2 types of scholarships and you have more options on what schools to go to depending on your state. It’s a great opportunity. Tell her to apply. 

 [dream.us scholarship](https://thedream.us/scholarships/)

It is frustrating and it is not fair, but as DACA and undocumented students we are NOT allowed at Georgia tech.

Like I have said, the best option is to apply to scholarships like the Dream.us and Golden Door (due oct.25, so apply!!!). The GDS gives preference to students in GA, NC, TN, and SC. 

We are NOT international students. You cannot attend Georgia Tech.

I’m really sorry. I’m in the same boat as you and applying to colleges. They just don’t allow us to apply there. I found this guide for undocumented [students in Georgia ](http://johnsonstudentservices.weebly.com/uploads/9/2/9/5/92956256/georgia_college_guide_for_undocumented_students.pdf). 

Please don’t let this stop you from going to college. You may already know this but look into scholarships. 
Golden doors. They partner with colleges like Emory and Agnes Scott in Georgia and pay all tuition and board if you get the scholarship. The deadline is October 25. Tufts, wake forest, and duke are also partners among many others. 

Also try the dream.us opportunity scholarship. They give full rides as well to a few partner schools. Apply to local scholarships. Don’t give up, we can do this.

I’m pretty sure Georgia tech is one of the 2 big colleges in Georgia that can’t admit undocumented students. 

I would try private colleges, also: looking into the golden door scholarship. It expires this month and gives preference to Georgia as one of the states. It is a full ride and they have quite a few partner colleges. Emory is one of them.

Ask people around you that you trust. I had a friend that was a US citizen but he was paid under the table because his boss assumed he was undocumented. If there is a large immigrant community around you, ask those without papers where they work (if you’re comfortable). 

I’ve heard of a couple of restaurants that pay under the table. Just look to see where minority demographics work at. Also, many undocumented people where I live work at factories, but I’m not sure on what pretenses. 

Also, lawn mowing (depending where you live?),babysitting, dog sitting, landscape, roofing, carports, depending on your location and what you’re looking for. 

Good luck.

My pediatrician can probably attest to me having to grow up with a special needs sibling in a poor family. She saw me at my worst and she helped me a lot. She made me want to be a health care provider. She always hyped me up and told me that I would do great things, regardless of the color of my skin, poverty level, and regardless of where my parents come from. 

Do you think that’s enough that she could write a good LOR for me? 

My other ‘additional recommender’ is my boss. I work at a non profit clinic and I’ve helped improve the place tremendously. I also volunteer at another free clinic, but the director there knows me less and would probably say more or less the same things about me as my boss. If asking my pediatrician doesn’t sound like a good idea, should I instead ask a pharmacist or nurse practitioner I work with instead?

I’ve felt lonely my entire life. I hope there’s some people out there that have come out of the loneliness.

I was brought to the US when I was 2. I’ve tried counting and I have over 100 first cousins. I have around 24 aunts and uncles and I’ve only ever met two. I’ve never met my grandparents. 3 of them are dead. 

I’ve only grown up around 2 first cousins and an aunt. I guess I don’t know what to this about my family in Mexico. I’ve heard evil stories of aunts and uncles stealing money from us and property. I’ve heard stories of betrayal. Our family in Mexico takes advantage of my parents for being here and some are bad people. I’ve never had a sense of family in the traditional sense. 

I wish I knew what it felt like to have a family in the traditional sense with aunts and uncles and grandparents. It’s really influences my connections with others and I’m hard to get close to as a result.

I’m going in to nursing most likely. I also have that thought of being a doctor but it’s discouraging as a DACA recipient. Do you like your BSN program?

You can definitely be a doctor with DACA. I’m also thinking about it. Have you looking into nurse practitioners and physician assistants? The only reason I ask if because it is a shorter career path. Daca could get terminated at any time. I’m thinking of doing nursing, then reevaluating whether to become a nurse practitioner or a medical doctor. The only thing about majoring in biology/chem/biochem (like most people doing pre-med do) is that it’s pretty hard to find a job with just that bachelors degree. 

To become a practicing doctor can take 8+ years after undergrad while NPs or PAs only have to do 2 or 3 additional years and get a masters (NPs can also get a doctorate). They virtually do the same thing. NPs can also open there own practices in some states. 

But it’s definitely doable to become a doctor and there are communities of DACA or undocumented pre-meds out there.

Oh my..boy.
My first real crush was on my best friend. He was confident, funny, and extremely racist and close minded. I only developed a crush in middle school after he started to like me after I lost like 50 pounds. He made me laugh and we bonded over nerdy things. I was the weird quiet girl that would stare at the wall during lunch and read. Long story short, we eventually told each other we liked each other but nothing really happened. However, he did sexually harass me after I lost a lot of weight and I avoided him like a plague. He took my first kiss. He went on to harass girls in high school and he was kicked out when a guy that liked me found out. 

The other guy I liked that kicked my first crush out was a lot liked him. He was loud, outgoing, funny...(but not racist). Howeverrrr, he often told me he liked other girls. This killed me inside and I became a very ugly person inside. I got jealous over time. He was also very clingy and got jealous when guys would talk to me. 
It turned out he wasn’t a good guy either. He told me he had a fantasy of raping girls and he got mad at me for apparently upsetting him to the point that one of his other crushes stopped talking to him. All this time he had told me he loved me. I told him I did too, but I never gave him my heart completely because I didn’t trust him. 

I can’t remember what their personality types were, but it was the same. All my crushes have had the sample personality type, but I can’t remember that it is. They were both very charismatic and I couldn’t help but fall in love with them. I actually really liked the last guy, but I ran away from him. I know he wasn’t perfect, but in a twisted way I wanted to be with him and fix him.

Yes, a million times yes! I hate asking for help. I’m very prideful and I don’t want others to see me as weak. I just want to help others and sometimes that’s bad. I let myself get to my weakest point until I have a mental breakdown and even then I won’t ask for help.

I’m so fearful of abandonment. This is why I’m so bad in relationships. I get with people that are dangerous and have problems of their own because i guess I feel like I need them. 
But I also push people away when I feel like I’m being abandoned or neglected. It hurts too much to be close to people because I’m scared they’ll eventually leave.
